draft.briefing: Hey, you're at Girgaon Chowpatty! This public beach sits on a stretch of Marine Drive, and the new Chhatrapati Sambhaji Maharaj Coastal Road starts right nearby.
draft.hungryLine: My notes don't name a place to eat here, but Chira Bazaar nearby is known for its fish market.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Swami Samartha Math is 3 minutes away, St Francis Xavier Church is about 6 minutes on foot, and the Taraporewala Aquarium is out on Marine Drive.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Wander into Khotachiwadi, a heritage village in Girgaon with old Portuguese-style houses.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Old Bombay once got all its drinking water from tanks like CP Tank, built in 1776, and today all that's left of it is a plaque opposite Metro Cinema.

spots.name: Taraporewala Aquarium
spots.detail: On Marine Drive · India's oldest aquarium, with a 180-degree glass tunnel

spots.name: Khotachiwadi

spots.name: Ambroli Church
spots.detail: In Girgaum · Started in 1831 by missionary John Wilson

legends.title: The jackfruit lane
legends.body: Fanas is Marathi for jackfruit, and the neighbourhood's name probably points to a time when jackfruit trees grew all over here. Locals call its Venkateshwara temple the Balaji mandir.

tips.title: Mind the evening peak.
tips.body: Southbound fast locals skip Charni Road station between 17:00 and 20:00, so take a slow train then.

tips.title: Find the CP Tank plaque.
tips.body: Look for it on a wall opposite Metro Cinema, the last trace of an old city water tank.

story.title: A tank for water
story.body: Cowasji Rustamjee Patel built CP Tank, one of the tanks that supplied Bombay's drinking water.

story.title: Ambroli Church
story.body: Scottish missionary John Wilson started a church in his home, Ambroli House, with services in Hindustani, Marathi and English. It led to Wilson College.

story.title: St. Teresa's opens
story.body: St. Teresa's High School was founded at Charni Road, and its present building went up in 1924.

story.title: Balaji of Fanas Wadi
story.body: The temple to Sri Venkateshwara at Fanas Wadi was consecrated on 10 June 1927.

story.title: Beach and coastal road
story.body: Girgaon Chowpatty and Marine Drive still draw crowds, and the coastal road now starts near the beach.
